gate_reason: Root cause is grounded in file:line stacking/offset code that explains why only the topmost Live Hits card fails while lower cards work. No material design ambiguity; fix is a layout correction (reliable controls height publish + stacking), not a product decision. Confirm on desktop ≥lg during QA.
synthesis: On the Scout driver map, the Live Hits Pending Repossession list (top-left card stack) lets lower rows open Hit Details, but the newest (top) row often ignores clicks. Code shows the desktop controls chrome (ScoutControlsWidget) is fixed at left-5 with z-[25], while the Live Hits column is absolute at left-5 with z-20 and is only kept clear of the chrome by CSS var --scout-controls-h published from a ResizeObserver that attaches once in onMounted and bails if the desktop widget is not mounted yet. When that height is missing/stale/underestimated, the opaque z-25 controls card physically covers the top of the z-20 Live Hits list — exactly the newest row — and eats the click. Lower rows sit below the overlap and work. Handler selectHitFromCard → focusHit is fine; this is not a missing click binding or a data-shape bug.

scope.summary: Stop the desktop Scout controls chrome from intercepting clicks on the top of the Live Hits Pending Repossession list. Make --scout-controls-h tracking reliable across compact↔desktop and expand/collapse, and ensure the Live Hits panel stacks above the controls when both occupy the left rail (or otherwise cannot be covered).

proposed_changes.change: Attach/detach ResizeObserver whenever the desktop rootEl becomes available (watch rootEl / isCompact / adminMode), not only in onMounted. Keep publishing --scout-controls-h on every size change including expand/collapse of the End Shift row.
proposed_changes.reason: onMounted early-returns when rootEl is null (compact or admin at mount). Later flipping to desktop driver never re-attaches the observer, so Live Hits keeps the 132px fallback while the real expanded widget is taller — overlap covers the newest card.

proposed_changes.change: Raise the Live Hits panel stacking above the controls chrome (e.g. z-[26] on the expanded Live Hits card / left column while expanded), and/or keep the left-column top offset strictly below the published height with a small safety gap. Prefer stacking so a stale height cannot eat clicks.
proposed_changes.reason: Even with a correct height, z-20 under z-25 means any overlap (animation frame, font scaling, End Shift appearing) silently steals clicks from the newest row. Stacking makes the list win.

proposed_changes.change: Use a stable :key on Live Hits rows (prefer scan_id ?? id) so a ~10s fetchRecentHits refresh does not remount the newest row mid-interaction more than necessary.
proposed_changes.reason: Secondary hardening for the ticket's live-update race hypothesis; newest row is the one whose identity changes most often on poll.
